utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right—the repair drive. I heard folks are gathering donations and spare parts this afternoon, so I was going to swing by and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that actually happening this afternoon, or is it just talk? I’d like to know before I go digging through my garage.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s happening this afternoon for real—I heard they’re setting up by the community center around three. If you’ve got anything handy, it’d be worth bringing along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up and see who can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik. Let me know if you hear anything—I might miss it if it gets changed around.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Noah. I’ll pass along any updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo—could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and a roll of duct tape? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure thing—I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about the repair drive. If you need a hand, let me know and I can stop by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I might take you up on that. I’m still sorting what we need most, so I’ll let you know once I’ve got it listed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye—that’d be great. I was thinking maybe Saturday morning, around 10, so folks can still make it after school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 works for me—I can help spread the word around the school crowd. Do you want me to mention a specific meeting spot?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we heading out, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, let’s aim for around 10 in the morning. If you can bring some gloves and maybe a couple trash bags, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 sounds fine to me. I’ll bring gloves and a couple trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, did you hear about the repair drive? I can spread the word and invite a few neighbors if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thanks. I’m mostly worried about the logistics, so a few extra people would be great.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll start inviting folks right away and keep it simple. If you want, I can also ask around for anyone who’s good with tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s still looking for a few more hands. If you want, I can pass along whatever I hear next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Nell—thank you. I’ll keep things organized on my end, and I’d appreciate any updates you hear.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course, Rosa—I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new. Thanks for keeping it all organized.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact time and which houses are on the list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have the exact time or house list in front of me right now, but I can check and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara—please do check and let me know when you have the exact time and house list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can pitch in a little, but I’ll need to keep it low-key. Just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, that works for me — even a little helps. I’ll let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate you keeping it quiet — just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand—what tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A wrench set and a screwdriver should do it. Do you have both?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both. I can bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive on my mind—do you need me to check where it’s headed next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’d help—just point me to the next stop when you can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the next stop and let you know as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — I can lend a hand and bring over some tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. Could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and maybe a drill if you’ve got one?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ve got a hammer, a set of screwdrivers, and a drill I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the logistics—do we know where people should drop things off and who’s handling the pickups?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Do we have a confirmed drop-off spot yet, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we’re still figuring it out. Maybe we should pin down one drop-off spot and a pickup person first so it doesn’t get messy.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I’ve been hearing good things about the repair drive. I’m happy to help connect folks who need stuff fixed with anyone who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules—thanks. I’m sure the neighbors will appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course, Mara—just point me to anyone who needs a hand, and I’ll spread the word. I’m glad to help out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of the supplies we still need for the repair drive. Just let me know what you’ve already got and I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a box of nails and two rolls of tape so far. I’ll keep you posted if I grab anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ve noted the nails and tape. Just send me the rest as you get it, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—people are dropping things off all afternoon. I can swing by later and see if they still need help sorting anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Tess—thank you. If you can come by later, I could really use an extra pair of hands sorting the donations.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Faye—I’ll stop by later and help sort everything out. Just let me know if there’s a rush job before then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can help a bit—just point me to what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — let’s start with the front steps and the loose railing by the community hall. If you can grab the repair list, I’ll show you where to begin.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll grab the repair list and meet you by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — what repair help do you need for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just need a hand checking the path and moving a few loose boards.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that. When do you want to check the path?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been meaning to tell folks — the repair drive is happening soon. I’ll spread the word around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for letting me know. I’ll keep an ear out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the time and place as soon as I hear it, and I’ll make sure the neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m happy to help keep track of where things need to go for the repair drive—just tell me the drop-off location and any updates, and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Let’s use the community center drop-off, and I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the community center as the drop-off location and wait for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Hana, what’s the plan for the repair drive? Do you need me to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for asking, Mina—let me double-check the list first so I don’t miss anything. I’ll let you know right away if we need supplies or tools.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, just let me know. I can swing by with whatever you need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard folks are still dropping off tools and materials for the repair drive. I’m heading past the community center later, so I’ll check if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be really kind of you, Ira. If you spot anything they’re short on, let me know and I’ll see what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Oren — I’ll swing by later and ask what they’re still short on. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know right away.
